S.FORM: = Nakahara = Gaga mniq Nantowseyn Jnaysyang ka alang nakahara. 284 sapah ka kneegu na sapah, 865 hiyi ka kana knhbragan na hiyi. Tnpusu seejiq o mangal 89% niqan 774 hiyi sp, rahuq na uxay tnpusu seejiq o mangal 11% niqan 91 hiyi koia. Kana ka kleegan seejiq ga, Seejiq/Seediq/Seejiq/Seejiq/Sediq73%, Tayal11%, Bunun2%, Amis2%, Paiwan1%. Hangan alang Alang Gluban Pnteanaq knmalu alang Sediq alang Gluban (Cing-ryo) pa to bay kluwanan Sediq kana, sediq tnualang tmhangan nanaq u alang Gluban mchaya. Nniqan na Nan-to-keyng Jin-ay-go Hu-cu-cwen alang Gluban. Llabang na Alang Gluban (Seyryo) pa wa mniq Nan-to-keyng Jin-ay-go Pryaxan hidaw, hruwan hidaw u msdalih alang Nakahara (Sediq Tgdaya) mi alang Baybara (Tayal) mi Hwey-swen rin-Cang, pryaxan hidaw pa lmutuc alang Kwo-sing-go alang Mey-rin (sediq Holo mi sediq Hakka), hruwan hidaw tuhunacu niqan Yayung Pey-kang ka mtqiri mi, pryaxan hidaw pa niqan Yayung Baykey, tudaya u niqan Dwiyaq Baybara ka sdharan, kiya ka wisu so thmuk kcka mi prmurux nanaq mi, so tssu bay mi mndungu baya alang. Lnglingay ti-ri Wa mniq ssiyaw yayung mi ayu. Pklaun pkla ppaan ruru M uda kwo-taw 1 Cong-san-kaw, uxay daw muda Kwo-taw 3 Formosa kaw-su-kong-ru→Kwo-taw 6 Swey-sa-ryeyn kaw-su-kong-ru→Mstabuy Kwo-sing cyaw-ryo-taw→Kwo-sing-ru→Cang-pey-ru→Cong-hwa-ru→Alang Buwarung. Pwaluk pnatas Rncuhan dieyn-cu Kkluwan tnsediq alang Ddiyun na kari Snhiyan kyokay Hangan alang Alang nakahara Pnteanaq knmalu alang Pnspuwan msupu alang sediq tgdaya paran, kacike, mi tacinan turu alang. Nniqan na Nan-to seyn ren-ay syang fu-cu cun. Llabang na Wa ruma ssipaw iril Bey-gaang-si ka nakahara, ddwiyaq tudaya Hou-tong-san, haypa 500 cm brnux dxral. Lnglingay ti-ri Brnux dxral. Pklaun pkla ppaan ruru Kndadax ell-kaw lmutuc strngan (caw-tung) elu cong-to>127 seyn elu pswayay(tuhunac) nan -to> Cong-to elu pslikaw>elupswayay fung-caw ru> fung-caw ru>bor-ay -ru>tong-san ru>cong-cng-ru>cong-daan-kong-ru>kwo-sing-ru>can-bey-ru>cong -hwey -ru>alang nakahara. Pwaluk pnatas Rncuhan dieyn-cu Pnatas rncuhan dieyn-cu alang. Kkluwan tnsediq alang Sediq. Ddiyun na kari Kari Sediq, kari Tlu. Snhiyan kyokay Pnyahan alang Alang Nakahara nii u wa mniq iril ssipaw ruwan yayung Bey-kan-si, ddwiyaq tudaya How-tong-san, haypa 500cm msbrnux dxral, wada pspuwan alang Tgdaya paran, kacike mi tacinan turu alang. Mnniq qwiyaq hungul tuhunac wuse ka paran, wa nniqan qmpringan mssik ( nniqan cuxal fong-jing-guan-ri-se)dhuq ngungu kaw-fong, mnniq dwiyaq ssipaw snuwil ka alsng kaciko, mnniq dwiyaq tuhunac alang kacuko ka alang takanan, haypa 1200cm. Babaw na ndaan wuse cmiyuk Tanah Tunux daw, keysacuTanahTunux nii u pswaaw wa mniq ruwan bay dwiyaq iril ssipaw yayung Mtudu ka alang kacuko mi alang takanan, mqriqu bay qlhangan, miicu sknuwan muda mrrudu,kiya mi mniq min-kwo 20 kngkawas (1931 kngkawas) 3 idas smkaun tdhlan nniqan na, thdilan na ssiyaw yayung Mtudu sipaw wuse, ( siyaw sapah pyasan kong wuse, saya pa langu sslian Wan-ta uxay uri u Bi-fu ), bukuy daw wada thdil ssiyaw alang paran natipiq slang rucaw(ruco), mnbahang kari Ciida pa adaw ka wada msdalih thdil alang saw ciwa, sapah tqian nii pa wada dha mhmtan smalu. Min-kwo 25kngkawas, phiyu smalu Wan-Ta Suey-Pa ka sediq Tanax Tunux, dmudul qsiya dhuq rju-yey-daan, tudaya wan-ta nniqan dxral ssiyaw yayung Mtudu wada maaqsiya kana. Alaw wada mlih dxral qnpahan , kiya niqan pnyahan na kari ka keysacu Tanah Tunux, pniqun na alang icil ka paran, takanan, kacuko turu alang, hiti bay umaaw alang buwala siyaw qsiya msbrnux dxral phiyu alang, alaw wa mniq kcka Uluban m iBuwala kiya pnhangan dha"nakahara"(nakahara), sediq Uluban nii u adaw nniqan hini niqan bay rngcux, naqah ka dxral hini , sun dha "meapung" ; pradingan nngalan Tlu ka Taywan nii priyux Pklaun pkla rmiwaw qqtaan Pusu bay pnskraya Sapah ptasan Nakahara Nan-to seyn ren-ay syang fu-cu cun cong- hwa-ru 3 haw Sapah pyasan tutipiq fu-cu "546"Nan-to seyn ren-ay syang fu-cu cun cong-hwa-tu1 haw
